notes.title: Long Awaited January Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has supported this game, the update promised in January is finally live! Due to hardware issues, corrupted files and other problems the update had to be delayed massively but the game will continue to be worked on and supported now and in the foreseeable future. 

Here are the changes in the update as mentioned in the January announcement: 

A new map

A movement rework including sprint and slide functions.

Bug fixes and general improvements

tags.feature: A movement rework including sprint and slide functions.

notes.title: FIRST UPDATE
notes.content:
Red Rage is having its first update next week. 

A new, far more dynamic map will be introduced, with more verticality and complexity. 

A movement rework will also be added which will make character control far more fluid by introducing sprint and slide functions.

More updates with maps, enemy types, weapons and even game modes will be coming over the next few months so watch for announcements as they come! 

Finally, I’d like to thank everyone for the support they’ve given to this game over its first month, with all the feedback and encouragement. It’s with everyone’s help that I’m able to create an experience that people enjoy and I look forward to improving the game over time.
